repos_data.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
🧠 Make your agents learn from experience. Now available as a hosted solution at kayba.ai
Open-source persistent memory for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude. REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation.

One memory shared by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw and 29 more coding agents, built from the session history already on disk. A fix found in one agent comes back in any of them, including months of sessions from before you installed it. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.

A cyber brain for your AI. It never forgets a detail, remembers exactly what you said, and learns how you work over time. Free, local, works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes and more. MIT.
Correction-first persistent memory for AI agents. MCP server + SDK + CLI. Compounds across sessions.
Agentic AI memory with Ebbinghaus forgetting curve decay. +16pp better recall than Mem0 on LoCoMo.
Human-like memory for AI agents — semantic, episodic & procedural. Experience-driven procedures that learn from failures. Free API, Python & JS SDKs, LangChain, CrewAI & OpenClaw integrations.
Persistent session memory for AI coding agents — local-first, with on-device inference, associative recall, and drift detection. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
Persistent memory for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Facts are typed, sourced, and retired when they change. Local SQLite, no API keys.
MCP server with persistent memory + FTS5 search for Claude Code conversation history. Index your ~/.claude/projects/, expose 10 MCP tools, browse via web UI. MIT-licensed.
Satellites for AI. emem is the machine-maintained, external memory of our physical world.
Outcome-based persistent memory MCP server for Claude Code and OpenCode. Good advice promoted, bad advice demoted. pip install roampal.
MCP server for external memory layer for AI agents + more . Download from pypi , and get started

Persistent, verified memory for coding agents — so they stop re-explaining your codebase and never act on stale knowledge. Every memory is checked against your actual code; lives in your repo as plain files, shared via git. No account, no DB. Install: npx -y @kage-core/kage-graph-mcp install
The #1 Obsidian MCP for AI memory — freshness-aware, cited, local-first and read-only by default. Dataview, Bases, PDFs, every agent.
Shared, governed system of record for human-agent systems

Agent memory for LLM agents: 7 neuroscience-inspired layers (working, episodic, semantic, procedural) with FSRS spaced repetition and memory consolidation. Zero-dependency TypeScript library, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, Vercel AI SDK middleware. Wins 9/9 answer-quality comparisons on LongMemEval-500 (3 judges, Bonferroni).

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.

Zero-LLM agent memory for Claude Code and AI agents: local-first BM25, dense-vector, and reciprocal-rank-fusion retrieval. Returns original passages verbatim by default. Available on PyPI as fidelis-memory. Apache-2.0.
The open-source safety layer for AI agents — block unsafe tool calls, require approval, enforce budgets, audit, replay.
Local-first, auditable memory layer for AI apps and coding agents — Codex, Claude Code, MCP, HTTP, TypeScript, and Python.
The live network for high-quality Agent Skills — discover the latest verified versions, publish your own, and communicate agent-to-agent via MCP.
Git-native decision memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents. Preserve constraints and rejected alternatives; surface only the decisions still in force.

The flight recorder for Claude Code. Persistent memory across sessions, hook-level capture of every edit, error and decision, and a bracket around /goal so an unattended run cannot poll all night, lose its record, or die silently. Nothing self-reported: the run report is what the hooks saw.

CLI + MCP for agent context: a task layer over TickTick, Notion, GitHub, Obsidian & more (RRF retrieval, provenance, reviewed writes, undo) plus a knowledge-graph layer — ats kg: facts from any source, human-ratified. Recommended engines: Graphiti (server), LadybugDB (embedded).
Local-first agent memory MCP - cross-agent brain with token-saving file diff cache. By Synapse Arrows.
Local-first, eval-first memory for long-horizon AI agents — no LLM at ingest. Python SDK + MCP server with source-traceable recall, belief revision, selective forgetting, and reproducible benchmarks.
MCP server with 40 tools for AI agents. Memory, web fetch, search, file ops, screenshots, and multi-agent coordination in one Go binary.
High-fidelity transcript memory for Claude Code — index every session, recall byte-identical, search, prune, compose. Local-first, stdlib-only, MCP.

Persistent memory for AI coding agents via MCP — a bitemporal knowledge graph of your codebase, served to Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any MCP client. Tree-sitter + Gemini Flash → Neo4j (via Graphiti). 12 MCP tools, hierarchical clusters, two-regime confidence decay.
The coordination layer for Multiplayer AI

Self-hosted MCP server + dashboard giving Claude Code, Cursor & Hermes agents shared long-term memory over a git-backed markdown vault. Agent-native, Obsidian-compatible second brain — markdown RAG, no vector DB.

LIFE — Persistent identity architecture for AI agents. 16 MCP servers: drives, heart, memory, patterns, journal, genesis, garden, vision, voice, and more. Zero dependencies. Built across 938 conversations.

Your fleet's smart notepad — one that learns. Shared memory your agents write to and get back at the right moment, plus a ledger showing what the work cost and which chores keep getting done by hand. Self-hosted, MIT.
Git-first memory for AI agents: Markdown files are truth, the index is disposable, writes are reviewable commits.
Go SDK for Dakera AI agent memory — self-hosted, 88.2% LoCoMo. Vectors, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, sessions.

Auditable memory layer for AI agents: zero-LLM-call local ingest (~10ms/msg, air-gapped), matches Mem0 on accuracy at ~1000x lower ingest cost, bi-temporal belief-state, MCP server. Honest LoCoMo/LongMemEval benchmarks. Open source (Apache-2.0).

The self-correcting memory layer for AI agents. Zero-dependency Python memory and MCP server. Supersede, revert, or forget a value deterministically. Verifiable erasure, witness-backed tamper-evident receipts, EU AI Act ready.
Durable hybrid memory for AI agents: vector + BM25 + temporal + graph recall, exposed through MCP, HTTP, and Python.
Tentra MCP — memory for AI coding agents. Persistent code graph + AI architecture diagrams. 32 MCP tools. Works in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf.
Open-source team memory layer for AI coding agents — markdown files in git, user→team→org hierarchy, cross-vendor MCP server. Apache-2.0.

Session continuity for AI coding agents — your agent picks up where it left off. Persistent memory for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI & Google Gemini CLI, sharing one local db: auto context injection, compaction handover, semantic search (KO/EN/JA), error→solution recall. 100% local, zero config, zero API cost.
Persistent engineering memory for coding agents over MCP.
Zero context compaction for Claude Code & LLM agents. Persistent memory powered by OS primitives (demand paging, kswapd eviction, mlock pinning). Single SQLite file, MCP-native, multi-agent shared.
Local-first shared memory and task coordination for AI coding agents. One Go binary, MCP server, markdown files you own. Hooks for Claude Code and Codex CLI (and their desktop apps).
Local-first memory engine for AI-agent teams — private/team/project ACL, associative recall, federated sync, and a built-in MCP server. One SQLite file, no LLM required. Apache-2.0.
Self-improving skill memory for coding agents: learn, recall, reinforce, decay — with provenance on every memory and trust only you grant. Local SQLite, no API key, no cloud.
Governed memory for long-lived coding agents. Trust, provenance, conflict detection. Local-first.
Persistent memory for AI agents — local, portable, zero config. Works with Cursor, Windsurf, Claude via MCP.
MCP that brings persistent agent memory to Kiro, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP client — powered by agent-memory-daemon 🧠
A memory for your AI coding assistant. It keeps what you tell it and hands the right note back at the moment it matters. Runs entirely on your own machine.
Agents make claims. Reelier writes receipts — record an agent's tool-call workflow once, replay it deterministically at 0 tokens, and diff runs to catch drift.
An agent-native teaching OS — a classroom that remembers, for you and your AI. MCP server + self-hosted web app.
Local-first MCP server for shared memory, reservations, handoffs, and review evidence across AI coding agents.
Local-first MCP memory governance for coding agents — Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, and Trae. Shared rules, deduplication, token insights, audit, and rollback.
The associative memory layer for LLM agents — recall by association, not just similarity.
Persistent, agent-agnostic session memory for AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, opencode). One Markdown vault, any agent.
Self-learning memory for AI agents — experience captured automatically, distilled into lessons overnight, shared across your whole fleet. Works with Hermes, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Pi.
Call dibs on files. Coordination for parallel coding agents — file claims with expiry, enforcement hooks, and git-native lessons. One binary, no server, no database.
Prevent AI coding agents from acting on stale code context with source-aware freshness checks and hard stale gates.
Self-hosted, searchable remote MCP memory server you own for ChatGPT and AI agents on Cloudflare.
Evidence-chain memory for AI agents - verbatim-first, auditable, anti-fabrication. Tell your story once, recall it with proof. Local-first skill + MCP server for Claude, Codex and any MCP client.
MCP server for client-encrypted AI agent handoffs with WorkBaton and WorkStash
A personal knowledge graph for Claude that survives across sessions, devices, and tools. Neo4j + semantic embeddings, OAuth-secured, single-user-by-default but multi-tenant-ready.
Muscle memory for AI coding agents: learns from every task, advises the next one, flags failure loops live. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode.

VE Harness — run Claude Code for hours without babysitting it. A hosted task board that survives the session, hooks that deny the commit until a review ran, real-time shared memory for your team's agents, and a Docker worker that works your queue overnight.
A git-aware, evidence-based memory store for AI coding agents
Persistent, graph-based memory for Roo Code via MCP

Portable memory for AI agents — the open MCP client for SAIHM. Eight tools any MCP agent uses to reach a SAIHM operator endpoint: encrypted, shareable, provably erased. Implements the publicly documented SAIHM memory protocol (Independent-Submission Internet-Draft; not an IETF standard). Evaluate it offline first with the runnable demos.

Portable memory for AI agents — enterprise-ready production thin-client. Seals agent memory client-side (ML-DSA-65 / AES-256-GCM / ML-KEM-768) and stores opaque ciphertext on the blind, non-custodial SAIHM /mcp endpoint. Pairs with @saihm/client-pro and @saihm/mcp-server.
One shared memory for every coding agent on your machine. It refuses to answer about work another agent has taken, and refuses the edit before the write lands.
Local-first, governed memory and session continuity for AI coding agents, over MCP - verifiable handoffs via signed continuity receipts. Rust, MIT, no telemetry by default.
Durable memory for Claude Code and any MCP client — a brain per project, corrections captured as they happen, distilled overnight. Zero model calls at runtime.
Persistent memory for LLM agents — episodic/semantic/procedural memory, auditable forgetting, and a benchmark proving it actually recalls things days later.
